verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 104.6 (+0.8% in a day) and momentum is 39: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 1,900 and 86s 4,000. Rivals rewards just paid out, so fodder supply is high this morning.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 4,600 coins. Now 4,000. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 4,600 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Sell Alessia Russo 88 after its 28% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 12,250 coins. Now 11,500. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 27.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Rivals rewards just paid out: buy SBC fodder now, not later
moves.detail: Rewards add fodder to the market on Thursday morning, which usually makes it cheapest then. Buy what your SBCs need now; selling it again costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 1,900 (0.90 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,000 (0.98 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,000 (1.09 coins per Item Score point), 88s 9,600 (1.16 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Désiré Doué and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Désiré Doué 86 Rare -46.5%; Bradley Barcola 85 Rare -42.9%; Alphadjo Cissè 85 Star Performer -34.2%; Vicky López 84 Rare -31.8%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Cora Zicai SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 26.3K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
